explanation: The lemma writes x - v_k as ∑ j, coord j x • (v_j - v_k) for the affine basis of a triangle in ℂ. The proof uses AffineBasis.sum_coord_apply_eq_one and AffineBasis.linear_combination_coord_eq_self. Neither of those is the statement itself. I read AffineSpace/Basis.lean and grepped Mathlib for coord-weighted sums of differences or vsubs. I found no lemma in Mathlib that gives the difference form directly. Getting it from the two lemmas above takes several steps: distribute the scalar over the subtraction, split the sum, and use the two facts. That is more than a one- or two-line derivation.
